title: Ledger and Orchard
author: I. M. Eriksen
blurb: Ivo Voss, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
